note: First published schema of the nexus verify --json document (also the receipt --receipt writes), generated from VerifyJsonOutput in cli/src/verify_contract.ts on release/v1.3.0. Nothing was published before it: the document of the first nexus verify slice had no schema, and its typecheck and guard members (then always NOT_RUN) take their real shapes here.

Additive, schema_version stays 1 (nexus verify --sandbox, VR-1 slice 3). New optional members: sandbox (requested, engine, network) on the result and sandboxed on each entry of runs; this producer always writes both, and they are optional in the schema so that a document written before them still validates. One new value of the reason enumeration: SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE (verdict BLOCKED, exit 3), written only when --sandbox was requested; a document with it does not validate against the earlier schema text, whose enumeration is closed. No member was removed or renamed and none changed type or meaning; a consumer that ignores unknown members and treats an unknown reason as not VERIFIED is unaffected.

Bump schema_version because sandbox.requested now means the operator explicitly selected a sandbox; implicit default confinement is reflected by the effective engine and per-run sandboxed facts. This changes the field's meaning, so consumers must reject version 2 until they account for the distinction.
